description: The hidden YouTube extractor webview (label sk-yt-extractor) navigates to youtube.com to read the player's own signed audio-stream URL, then hands it back to Rust by EMITTING sk-yt-extracted / sk-yt-extract-failed. Like the main SPA it is REMOTE content, so — matching the default capability's rationale — it gets only core:event (emit/listen/unlisten); it cannot invoke app commands or touch the filesystem. Scoped to the youtube origins it loads. The download files themselves are served to the main window by the skdl:// URI scheme handler (registered in main.rs), which needs no capability.
